ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white dominates approximately 85-90% of the visible surface area, contrasted against low-intensity black margins and basal markings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity (white) field occupying the central and distal lobe regions. Low-intensity (black) perimeter bands. Distinct series of 4-5 horizontal, dark chevron-shaped pixel clusters localized at the basal junction.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp, deep V-shaped indentation with an acute interior pixel angle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular jagged peaks and valleys. Significant macro-scale indentation (missing pixel mass) on the left lobe trailing edge creating a non-linear disruption.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the distal margins transitioning to a sharp downward gradient toward the central notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast white pixel clusters (consistent with barnacle colonization) localized at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes. Sparse circular pockmarks on the interior lobe surfaces.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint diagonal linear pixel disruptions detected on the mid-to-lower region of the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large, irregular traumatic notch on the trailing edge of the left lobe. Barnacle clusters present on distal lobe tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinct dark chevron-patterned pigmentation at the base of the fluke near the water line.
